verdict.rationale: Bruno is offline-only, with no cloud sync, account, or login. Collections are stored as plain-text files in a local folder, so the user decides what is kept and what is deleted. Bruno AI uses bring-your-own-key, with no data routed through Bruno servers, including local models such as Ollama, so AI traffic does not pile up on vendor infrastructure. Missing for 10: documented retention or deletion controls (e.g. clearing request/response history or cached tokens), guidance on how long AI provider requests are kept under BYOK, and independent hands-on confirmation.
